rules.name: HS Code Validity
rules.description: Each HS code must be exactly 8 digits and exist in BTKI

rules.name: CIF Consistency
rules.description: CIF value must equal FOB + Freight + Insurance within 0.5% tolerance

rules.name: NIB Format
rules.description: NIB (Nomor Induk Berusaha) must be exactly 13 digits

rules.name: NPWP Format
rules.description: NPWP (Nomor Pokok Wajib Pajak) must be exactly 15 digits

rules.name: Container ISO 6346
rules.description: Container numbers must match ISO 6346 format: 4 alpha + 7 digits

rules.name: BL Number Consistency
rules.description: B/L number must match across all uploaded documents

rules.name: Weight Consistency
rules.description: Gross weight across documents must match within 1% tolerance

rules.name: Package Count Match
rules.description: Package count must match across B/L and Packing List

rules.name: Vessel Name/Voyage Match
rules.description: Vessel name and voyage number must match across all documents

rules.name: Date Sequence
rules.description: B/L date must be <= ETD <= ETA at destination

rules.name: UN/LOCODE Validity
rules.description: Port loading and discharge codes must be valid UN/LOCODEs

xgboost_fallback_rules.description: Rule-based rejection risk when XGBoost model is unavailable (< 500 labeled samples)

description: Cross-document validation rules CV001-CV011 for CEISA 4.0 declaration processing. Hot-reloadable — update without restarting the service (send SIGHUP to worker). Never hardcode these rules in Python.
